Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19747 Act Number: 7 Enactment Date: 1974-02-15 Act Year: 1974 Short Title: The Telangana Districts (Formation) Act, 1974. Long Title: An Act to provide for the formation of districts in the State of Telangana and for alteration of areas or boundaries of the districts in the interests of better administration and development of the areas comprised therein and for matters connected therewith.
